refactor: migrate url modules to Typescript (#14719)

This PR converts our `url.js` module and `origin-url` webcomponent to Typescript, adding appropriate types along the way. This continues !14508's scoped approach to tightening our frontend type-checks, in line with @JakobDev's assessment in https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/5859#issuecomment-2560264.

[v17.0/forgejo] fix(ui): proper use of modern components in org teams ui (#14759)

**Backport**: #14752

Fixes forgejo/forgejo#14750.

Regression as result of combining #14281 with #13943 and #13630.

Styles in modern `button.css` were never supposed to act as overrides of Fomantic styles, but in a few places during v17 devcycle they ended up doing that before they broke.

As currently `button.css` does not offer alternative to Fomantic's `tiny` buttons those were just reverted to be fully Fomantic governed.
